summary: Set http_proxy, https_proxy and no_proxy on every control plane node (optionally in /etc/environment to make them permanent); the installer then sends external traffic through the proxy, and Podman uses it for containerized installs.
questions: Which environment variables set the egress proxy for AAP nodes?
How do I make the proxy settings permanent with /etc/environment?
Does the AAP installer use http_proxy during installation?

answer_card.title: System-level egress proxy
answer_card.answer_md:
On every control plane node set (or add to `/etc/environment`):
```bash
http_proxy="http://external-proxy_0:3128"
https_proxy="http://external-proxy_0:3128"
no_proxy="localhost,127.0.0.0/8,10.0.0.0/8"
```
The installer and, for containerized installs, Podman then use the proxy.
